correctness.rationale: A transitive subtournament of the cyclic tournament lies in one cyclic block, giving \(\operatorname{dFl}(R_n)=\mathcal N(n,m)\). Reversing only \(0\to1\) preserves every old simplex, creates exactly the transitive triangle \(\{0,1,m+1\}\), and creates no larger new simplex. The three corresponding circular arcs cover the circle, have pairwise but no triple intersection, and therefore their boundary-triangle nerve includes into \(\mathcal N(n,m)\) by a homotopy equivalence; filling that loop makes the pushout contractible. Independent enumeration for odd \(n=3,5,7,9,11,13\) reproduced exactly one added triangle and no deleted faces.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration is corroborative only; the all-order conclusion uses the structural proof.
